tools.name: list_database_skill_files
tools.title: List Database Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'database' skill, the platform's guidance for querying relational and graph databases from an app. Call this when the user asks about SQL, SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, table or schema structure, connecting to a database, or listing the databases they have access to, and when they name SqlQuery, SqlQueryBase64, GetDatabaseTableStructure, or MyEngines(engineTypes=["DATABASE"]). Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for LLM calls (see the model skill) or vector/semantic search (see the vector skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The database skill (database). Always this value.

tools.name: read_database_skill_file
tools.title: Read Database Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'database' skill in full, for writing code that queries a platform database through runPixel. Pass filePath exactly as list_database_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers when to use SqlQuery versus SqlQueryBase64 (dynamic SQL, quotes, Unicode, newlines), inserts/updates/deletes, reading table structure, the response shape, and listing databases with filtering and paging.

project.title: project
project.description: The database skill (database). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_database_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
